question: The game has five temperament dimensions (deliberation, sociability, conflict, reliability, risk) and nothing else a person carries as a trait. ChatGPT's earlier answers (ordinary-life-trait-set, A01) said to retain the five dimensions and implement the 121-word catalogue in complete behavioural families. The owner has now said five is unacceptable: he wants people to carry many distinct, combinable traits in the Crusader Kings manner, so someone can be industrious and also shameless and lustful. So: (1) from the 121 dispositions, which should ship as distinct carried traits in the first set, and which stay as combinations or facets of the five; (2) how traits combine on one person, including which are mutually exclusive and which commonly co-occur; (3) what each carried trait concretely changes in play (choices offered, NPC reactions, relationship movement, political behaviour) so no trait is a label only; and (4) how the one-or-two salient starting traits interacts with carrying more traits over a lifetime.

readFirst.words: First, five core traits plus one for legislators is unacceptable. I need personality traits and, and stuff. That's why I used uh, Crusader Kings as, as, as an example, because someone can be industrious, but also shameful and lustful or something. [...] there needs to be more than five traits. That's ridiculous. Uh, but if ChatGPT is going to take care of that, that's fine.

requestedBy: research intake thread, from lamontae's message of 2026-09-22T20:02Z

sourcesChecked.whatItDidNotSettle: They give dispositions for all 121 and say to retain five dimensions and implement complete families; they do not name a first shipping set of carried traits, their combinations or their effects, and the owner has rejected five-only.
Confirms the five traits stored as -2..+2; nothing else a person carries.

title: Which of the 121 become traits a person actually carries, Crusader Kings style
usableAnswer: A named first shipping set (trait id, meaning, exclusive-with list, typical co-occurrences) with at least one concrete in-play effect per trait, plus a rule for how many traits a person accumulates over a life. A statement of which of the 121 are deliberately left as facets of the five dimensions is part of a complete answer.
whyItMatters: The owner ranks relationships and personality first among his priorities. Today every person is five numbers, so people feel alike; he said directly that five traits is ridiculous. The engineering lane needs a first shipping set with concrete effects, or it will either build 121 inert labels or keep five.
